text:
Cloud cost is running 25.2% above its baseline (high severity). The increase began at 2026-09-22 10:00 UTC and was detected at 2026-09-22 12:00 UTC.

The likely root cause is image-service (root-cause confidence 78%). Its own behaviour changed, and the extra load spread along image-service -> cdn. The next candidate, api-gateway (33%), was ruled out: its load rose x1.82, but it only forwards user traffic; the extra requests belong to the services behind it. Estimated impact traced to image-service: $2,571/month.

Supporting evidence:
- User requests rose x4.42 (20,346 → 89,990 per minute)
- Accounts for 99% of the estimated cost increase through the services it calls
- Total calls to cdn rose x4.42
- Its change tracks the total cost curve (correlation 0.99)

Recommended: Rate-limit image-service to 1.2x baseline traffic. Estimated saving $2,467/month, latency +0.0%, error rate +0.0pp, risk medium.
